question: Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma, a renowned instrumentalist, published which of the following books as his autobiography?

options.text: Journey with a Hundred Strings: My Life in Music

solution:
The correct answer is __**Journey with a Hundred Strings: My Life In Music**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma is an Indian music composer and Santoor player from the state of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• He also composed music for many Hindi films in collaboration with Hariprasad Chaurasia (Famous Falutist).
 
• He was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in the year 1985.
 
• He received the 'Padma Shri Award' in 1991. He also received the Padma Vibhusan in 2001.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Santoor

 
 
• It is a trapezoid-shaped hammered dulcimer and a variation of the Iranian Santoor.
 
• It is generally made of walnut and has 25 bridges.
 
• Each bridge has 4 strings, making for a total of 100 strings.
 
• It is a traditional instrument in Jammu and Kashmir.
